searchText: Uhm, have another version with 2.25x improvement in gas cost... (i.e. from 45k gas to 20k for only leanXMSS sig verification). Sound quite wild, so I think I need Ethlib to have more test vectors, and prob do diff fuzzing against a reference impl to be sure about some stuff which was going to be useful anyway before we try to FV-it. Can share a bit more tomorrow after I'm a bit more sure about this. Awesome 🔥 <@427491045308235776> if we update the system contracts for PQ registrations & validator/builder preregistrations to check the signature, do we need domain separators (eg `DOMAIN_PREREGISTRATION`)? It would just feel a bit weird to have those defined in consensus-specs if they aren't actually used there. Since it's not really an onchain object, I don't think there's any risk in mixing it up with something. I think in practice, it should be safe without it. If we verify the signature in the EL contract (which means that we are committing to a signature scheme) then I think the CL would not need the `DOMAIN_PREREGISTRATION` Awesome. Just pushed https://github.com/ethereum/consensus-specs/commit/e98cc6c472f3799af1e24ef3d819a324579a1bd1. I'd like to work under the assumption that the system contracts will verify signatures for now. We can always add this back if necessary.

excerpts.author: jsign
excerpts.content:
Uhm, have another version with 2.25x improvement in gas cost... (i.e. from 45k gas to 20k for only leanXMSS sig verification). 
Sound quite wild, so I think I need Ethlib to have more test vectors, and prob do diff fuzzing against a reference impl to be sure about some stuff which was going to be useful anyway before we try to FV-it.
Can share a bit more tomorrow after I'm a bit more sure about this.

excerpts.author: jtraglia
excerpts.content: <@427491045308235776> if we update the system contracts for PQ registrations & validator/builder preregistrations to check the signature, do we need domain separators (eg `DOMAIN_PREREGISTRATION`)?

excerpts.author: jtraglia
excerpts.content: It would just feel a bit weird to have those defined in consensus-specs if they aren't actually used there.

excerpts.author: jtraglia
excerpts.content: Since it's not really an onchain object, I don't think there's any risk in mixing it up with something.

excerpts.author: kevaundray
excerpts.content:
I think in practice, it should be safe without it. 

If we verify the signature in the EL contract (which means that we are committing to a signature scheme) then I think the CL would not need the `DOMAIN_PREREGISTRATION`

excerpts.author: jtraglia
excerpts.content: Awesome. Just pushed https://github.com/ethereum/consensus-specs/commit/e98cc6c472f3799af1e24ef3d819a324579a1bd1. I'd like to work under the assumption that the system contracts will verify signatures for now. We can always add this back if necessary.
